reviewPriorities: Review Italian original answers word-by-word for Q767–816 and compare source witness to a dated print exemplar.
Q770–775: confessor's jurisdiction and pastoral responsibility; do not assert an individual has invalid confession or should be denied absolution.
Q776–788: doctrinal distinctions between forgiven guilt and temporal punishment; explain grace and satisfaction through Christ, never dangerous asceticism.
Q789–794: Purgatory, intercession and duty to make restitution; no declarations about named deceased individuals.
Q795–807: indulgence doctrine versus changed disciplinary grants; obsolete days/years classification (Q803); actual 2026 Jubilee privileges must be verified.
Q808–813: historical 'Extreme Unction' eligibility and timing versus current Anointing of the Sick legislation; avoid withholding emergency care or priestly ministry.
Q814–816: sacramental Holy Orders and pre-1972 Latin minor orders distinguished from present discipline.
Deduplicate against earlier Penance and Eucharist waves, the 1912 catechism and the Ad Orientem Confession, Last Rites, prayer and Mass modules.
The original Italian Q text is typed from a public museum transcription; print proof, source-answer correspondence and EN/FR are not individually certified.
policies: All approval flags false. No publication, runtime imports, merges or synthetic personal Pope Pius X quotations.
